label: The resistor stamp
subgoals: Convert each resistance to a conductance
Add every conductance touching the node to its diagonal
Include resistors that run to ground

label: Off-diagonal entries and the ground row
section: Off-diagonal entries and the ground row
subgoals: Sum the conductances joining the two nodes directly
Negate that sum for the off-diagonal entry
Delete the ground row and column from every stamp

label: Assembling the whole matrix
subgoals: Stamp every element into a zeroed matrix
Cancel the four entries of each floating resistor in the sum
Sum the conductances to ground to predict the entry total
